test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: How many solid spherical balls each of 33 cm radius can be made out of a solid spherical ball of radius 66 cm?
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of small sphere (R₁) = 33 cm

Radius of the big sphere (R₂) = 66 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = (4/3) × π × r³

**Calculation:**

Let, N = number of spherical balls.

⇒ N × volume of small spheres = volume of big sphere

⇒ N × (4/3) × π × (R₁)3 = (4/3) × π × (R₂)3

⇒ N × (33)3 = (66)3

⇒ N = (66/33)3 

⇒ N = 2³ = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**
